notes.title: Auto buy option
notes.content:
Version 0.74a
Added auto buy. Auto buy must first be enabled in the gameplay settings.

When you press 'E' or double-click on a Tower placed on the field, that Tower will be marked. If Towers of the same type appear in the Tower Store, they will be bought immediately.

You can also set auto-buy for potions using these keys:
- Q + 1 for Milk potion
- Q + 2 for Frog potion
- Q + 3 for Regeneration potion
- Q + 4 for Vigor potion

(Based on Auto Buy Mod by Robin Schweitz)

notes.title: Balancing of the Royal Towers and the nearest plans
notes.content:
In addition to fixing bugs and all sorts of technical stuff, I really want to do further gameplay design, especially the actual action of the Towers themselves..

My immediate plans are as follows:.

 Revision of the Towers from the Royal Pack.
 Revision of the Towers from the Inferno Pack.
 New Towers.



Revision of the Towers from the Royal Pack
In previous updates, I have done work on the towers of the Royal Pack.

 Builder Tower: Gives 3 more HP.
 Thief Tower: more trap damage starting at level 4.
 Hydra Tower: bonus increases slightly with each level.
 Glass Tower: increased bonus growth starting at level 3
 Chest Tower: increased gold growth starting at level 3.


It is also worth noting that such towers as Cat Tower, Cow Tower, and Butler Tower have been improved since the demo. But these improvements went straight into the release.

In addition to this, one crown is now now restored after going to the second act. Also one crown is restored when entering endless mode.


Revision of the Towers from the Inferno Pack
In the near future I'm going to think about the Inferno Pack Towers. Some of them should get some minor changes, and some of them should probably be completely redesigned.


New Towers
The Guild Tower (for the Royal Pack) is currently in development. Several new Towers are also being drawn for the Royal Pack, and new Towers are being drawn for the Inferno Pack.

I don't know exactly how I'm going to bring the new Towers into the game. Maybe I'll have to make a separate, beta branch in Steam for them, in order to properly test these new Towers. But maybe there will be another way.

All of the above are immediate plans. Of course, there's a whole other set -- the Neromancer Pack, but that's a separate, major task. So I'm not describing it for now. 

Stay tuned, and thanks for your comments about the game!

notes.title: Epic Auto Towers released in Early Access!
notes.content:
Epic Auto Towers is finally released in Early Access!

For the Early Access release, some Towers received some small changes:

 Cat Tower (no change to the description, but the Tower now gets more bonus at high levels)
 Cow Tower (increased bonus from Milk Towers)
 Butler Tower (additional bonuses for some Towers)
 Well Tower (doubles the mana given with each level)
 Incubator Tower (new mechanics)
 Spire Tower (x5 experience gained)


I'll probably go into more detail about these changes later. But for now I will read the feedback, and try to fix all possible bugs as soon as possible :) And then I'll get to the new content and some possible balance tweaks.

notes.title: Epic Auto Towers on Steam's Endless Replayability Fest. Play the demo!
notes.content:
Epic Auto Towers is joining the Endless Replayability Fest on Steam. 

All games with a very high level of replayability are invited to participate, be it through procedurally generated maps, random character generation or even stories.

In Epic Auto Towers, of course, the main element of randomization is the Tower Store, which generates random Towers for purchase. These mechanics are supplemented by starting bonuses, relics dropped from bosses, tokens, etc.

You can see all of this in the demo version, even though it's a demo, it has a great replayability even. 
Play the demo!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2116060/Epic_Auto_Towers/
